protocol_title: EXP4 Phase 6 independent recording-group confirmation: elephant trajectories and virtual-boundary warnings
original_training_and_historical_test_gr: BIRDSAI historical partitions and WildBox elep1/elep2/elep3 have already been inspected

forecast_task.coordinates: camera-corrected normalized image plane; field-metric claims prohibited without verified georeferencing

primary_claim_to_test: 2-second clearance heuristic lowers moving-anchor virtual-boundary-instance FPR with a prespecified limit on recall loss on new recording groups
primary_evaluation_unit: capture recording group; instance counts are nested and overlapping
primary_eval_scope: new independent elephant RGB recording groups; source-equivalent moving-anchor synthetic-boundary instances; not physical fences
secondary_outcomes: per-group 2-second precision and recall; instance rates descriptive
per-group 5-second frozen-q90 pathwise window coverage and width/radius
fixed-reference deduplicated crossing-event sensitivity and unassociated alert runs
alert runs per observed monitoring hour only if continuous timestamps and eligibility coverage are available

research_design_targets_NOT_POWER_JUSTIF.group_count_shortfall: inconclusive; report per-group estimates and do not assert robust generalization

primary_decision_criteria_PROPOSED_NOT_Y.false_alert_rate_superiority: group-macro paired candidate - baseline must be < 0
primary_decision_criteria_PROPOSED_NOT_Y.confidence_interval_requirement: paired group-level uncertainty reported; formal confirmation only if study adequately powered and CI supports both criteria

rules_for_confirmation: obtain supervisor-approved protocol and documented preregistration timestamp before viewing new test outcomes
freeze capture-group IDs, inclusion/exclusion rules, policy, metrics and software hashes before test access
separate development, optional new calibration, and untouched confirmation groups
never recalibrate q90 on confirmation groups
keep RGB and thermal or red-deer/human cross-domain findings separately labeled
avoid ground-distance or physical alert claims absent independent geometry and direct observation
report negative and inconclusive results without retuning
open_gates: no newly collected independent elephant recording groups supplied
no new per-instance moving-anchor forecast/GT table supplied; no validated fixed-reference case table either
no collection permissions or ethical approval documented
formal sample size/power and recall margin require supervisor review
external registration/timestamp evidence has not been created

geometry_arms.secondary: segment_fixed_reference (only after validated uncertainty transport and GT fixed-reference labels)
